requirements.title: Name association has five forms and three cross-scope mechanisms
requirements.definition: Name association consists of argument association, use association, host association, linkage association, and construct association. Argument, use, and host association are mechanisms by which entities known in one scope may be accessed in another scope.

pending.five-name-association-forms: Source-control inventory cites the five owning catalogues: 19.5.1.2 argument association, 19.5.1.3 use association, 19.5.1.4 host association, 19.5.1.5 linkage association, and 19.5.1.6 construct association; each catalogue supplies its concrete sentinel plan.
pending.cross-scope-access-mechanisms: Cross-scope access is checked through the owning argument, use, and host catalogues using distinct integer sentinels 1, 2, 42, and -777 so wrong scope resolution changes an exact result.
